Mythic+ Vendor


Edrim Skysong is the Mythic+ Vendor. He offers gear, upgrades, Mythic+ equipment recycling, all in exchange for Mythic Coins, earned from Mythic+ dungeon runs.

You can find Edrim in the center of Shattrath

Visit him frequently to upgrade your equipment and exchange Mythic+ Coins for valuable rewards
